text: Hi! It's Lena. My flight was two hours late. I was very tired. Then I went to the wrong hotel! I had a sandwich at the airport. How was your journey?
Hi! It's Max. I stayed in a little hotel in a forest. My room was small, but it was very quiet. There wasn't any noise. I had a great dinner. How was your hotel?
Hi! It's Zoe. I went to the beach yesterday. It rained a lot. I was cold, so I went to a cafe. I had a very big pizza. It was great! How was your day?
Sorry I'm late. I went to the wrong hotel.
Sorry. I'm not hungry. I had dinner on the plane.
Sorry. Your room isn't very big.
Sorry. I don't want to go out. I did a lot yesterday. I'm very tired.
Hello. Welcome to the Treehouse Hotel. How can I help you?
Can I have your passport, please?
Thank you. Your booking is for one night. Is that right?
You're right. Two nights. Here's your key. Your room number is twelve. Do you have any questions?
Check out is at eleven. Is there anything else?
The password is Tree twelve. Enjoy your stay!

I went to a treehouse hotel. My room was small, but it was nice. I had pizza. There was a goat! I went to the beach. It rained a lot. I was tired, so I went to bed early. It was a very strange holiday. I loved it!
